gloss: to conjecture; to guess; to surmise
notes:
A formal word for guessing or conjecturing based on limited evidence. Also an important grammatical term in Japanese: {推量|すいりょう}{形|けい} (conjectural form) refers to verb endings like だろう and でしょう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {推量|すいりょう}{形|けい}: conjectural form (grammar term)
- ～から{推量|すいりょう}する: to surmise from ~
- {推量|すいりょう}の{域|いき}を{出|で}ない: to not go beyond conjecture
- {推量|すいりょう}にすぎない: to be merely conjecture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {推測|すいそく}する: to guess, to speculate — very close synonym; slightly more common in everyday usage
- {推察|すいさつ}する: to infer, to surmise — more formal; often implies sympathetic understanding
- {憶測|おくそく}する: to speculate — carries a negative nuance of unfounded speculation
- {見当|けんとう}をつける: to make a rough estimate — more casual

REGISTER:
Formal. More common in written language, academic discussions, and grammar terminology. In everyday speech, {推測|すいそく} or simply {想像|そうぞう} are more natural.

definitions.gloss: to conjecture; to guess; to surmise
definitions.explanation: to form an opinion or estimate about something without having complete information; to make an inference or educated guess

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{気持|きも}ちを{推量|すいりょう}する。
examples.english: To guess the other person's feelings.

examples.japanese: {状況|じょうきょう}から{結果|けっか}を{推量|すいりょう}するのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It is difficult to surmise the outcome from the situation.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{表情|ひょうじょう}から{推量|すいりょう}すると、あまり{賛成|さんせい}ではないようだ。
examples.english: Judging from his expression, it seems he doesn't really agree.
